read.thesis: Revenue up 39% to $24.4B with FY26 guidance raised to $91-92B, but U.S. price down 10% ex one-time adjustment and capacity is expanding via $11.5B of new U.S. plants.

capex.quote: Broke ground on $11.5 billion in new U.S. facilities, including a $6.5 billion site in Houston and a $5 billion site in Richmond.

triggers.label: U.S. price down 10% ex-adjustment
triggers.quote: Excluding this adjustment, U.S. price declined 10%.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue guide raised to $91-92B
triggers.quote: we now expect full year revenue to be between $91 and $92 billion

triggers.label: 2027 faces ~$2B one-time headwind
triggers.quote: the 2026 revenue benefited from approximately $2 billion of 1-time items

guidance.quote: we now expect full year revenue to be between $91 and $92 billion
We expect non GAAP earnings per share of $35 to $36

red_flags.label: Q3 revenue boosted ~$900M one-offs
red_flags.quote: Q3 revenue was positively impacted by approximately $900 million of previously mentioned items

red_flags.label: Net price erosion in U.S.
red_flags.quote: Partially offset by a 7% decline in price.

evasions.quote: we continue to guide to what we forecast in our internal bottom up approach
